content.short: CardanoTales is a CNFT collection and a CNFT-hybrid game project. Deep dive in the Dark BlockCave Maze.
content.description: CardanoTales is a CNFT collection and a CNFT-hybrid game project. The goal is to address the lack of proper games with a successful CNFT gamification. CardanoTales is a project of collectible CNFTs with gamified utility. CNFTs are implemented in the game engine and holders can play our games with token-access. Our CNFTs are: Characters, which allow for in-game login and everlasting-time access to the game; Weapons which are items with different rarity and allow in-game stats boosts (and some of them allow for secrets unlock).
